description: Map project evidence into a user-centered outcome arc for a product or design case study. Use when raw notes are chronological, the story lacks tension or a clear result, the product or designer has become the hero instead of the user, a journey needs a beginning-middle-end structure, or research and analytics must be connected to goals, conflicts, pivotal decisions, and measurable outcomes.
